claims.statement: Tom Allen of St. Louis was visiting New York City in September 1869.
claims.excerpt: is on a visit to this city

claims.statement: The St. Louis Republic, quoting the New York World, called Tom Allen 'our fistic champion'.
claims.excerpt: in honor of Tom Allen, our fistie champion:

claims.statement: Friends held a sparring reception for Tom Allen at the Hotel du Nord in the Bowery, New York.
claims.excerpt: the Hotel du Nord, in the Bowery, nearly opposite
places: Hotel du Nord, Bowery, New York City

claims.statement: Tom Allen sparred with Dwyer of Brooklyn at the reception.

places: Hotel du Nord, Bowery, New York City

claims.statement: Tom Allen made a speech of thanks to his hearers at the reception.

places: Hotel du Nord, Bowery, New York City

claims.statement: Tom Allen has a future fight with Mike McCoole, and said he would do his duty in it.
